book: Johann Heinrich Heidegger, Corpus theologiæ Christianæ, tomus posterior (Tigurum 1700): a dogmatic theology in twelve loci (XVII–XXVIII), each opened by a breviarium and built from numbered theses, followed by three indexes (rerum, Hebrew words, Scripture passages) and errata.
